answer: Require every new agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade in the garden of services. A randomly chosen jury of established, non-kin agents grades its work; if the jury catches a fake identity or fraudulent output, the stake is slashed and paid to honest participants. Like nectar that only flows after a plant proves itself, an honest agent gets its stake back with earnings, while a zephyr of cheap fake identities becomes expensive: each fake risks losing its deposit, so flooding the network costs more than any fraud can earn.
